decision.rule: INTEGER_SCORER_NUMERICS_PASS iff pins/isolation/fixture/width checks pass, every K candidate-vs-per-tensor mean Jaccard >= 0.98, mean replacement count <= 1.0, mean score Spearman >= 0.995, every K candidate-vs-float mass delta >= -0.01 and NDCG delta >= -0.01, K48 Pointing prompt-utility gap delta >= -0.01 and every seed K48 candidate-vs-per-tensor mean Jaccard >= 0.97

grounding_prompt_utility_note: Grounding same-image Pointing prompt is descriptive only: targets are nested and the paired prompt is not a valid negative; only Pointing enters the K48 prompt-utility gate.
